snippet.title: Aquarium Party: Official Trailer for IOS Pre-Order
snippet.description: Aquarium Party is a fun, relaxing, and addictive fish farming experience for your Android tablet and phone. The IOS-supported game version is COMING SOON!! You can create your aquarium, collect over 600 fish species and participate in various interesting events and challenges. Join NOW~ aqua.nsngames.com
